_comment: Hand-written notes for the specs of the OLD Pema web, merged into each screen's spec by web-specs.cjs and the pema-design MCP (record_web_note). groups.<WA..WH> applies to every screen of the group; screens.<ID> to one screen. Keys: logic, rules, differences, gotchas, todo (string arrays). Write in English; keep Vietnamese UI text and business wording verbatim in quotes. Differences never remove UI: the old web is the reference, the owner decides later (plan D8). Quick add: MCP tool record_web_note, or edit this file then run node .claude/skills/pema-web-design/scripts/web-specs.cjs.

logic: The shell is drawn once by `clinic.js › shell(content)`: `.sidebar` (menu filtered by `PemaStaff.allowed(page)`), `.topbar` (breadcrumbs, demo account picker, global search, bell, reset), then the page body.
rules: The account picker is a demo identity boundary, "NOT authentication or production RBAC" (header comment of `staff-context.js`).
gotchas: Role and page are kept in `sessionStorage` (`pema-staff`); a fresh browser context always starts as `owner-tam` unless `?staff=<id>` is in the URL.

logic: Operations pages are drawn by `crm-ui.js` (dashboard, today) and `operations-ui.js` (schedule and the booking dialogs); calculations live in `PemaCRM` and `PemaOps` (`operations-data.js`).
gotchas: The demo day is fixed: 2026-09-20 09:00 (`DAY` in `operations-data.js` and `crm-automation.js`). Dates before that day cannot be booked.

logic: Patient 360 is `clinic.js › patient360()`: hero, tab bar (`data-tab`), then one body per tab. `care-finance.js` injects the linked service/prescription panels under every tab except `crm` and `history`.
rules: Clinical actions need the `clinical` capability (owner, doctor); without it `action()` answers "Cần tài khoản bác sĩ để thực hiện." and `staff-context.js › apply()` removes the controls.
gotchas: Opening a patient from the list is a row click (`tr[data-patient]`) or the "Mở →" button; the tab is kept in the module variable `tab`, so a re-render keeps it.

logic: CSKH screens are drawn by `crm-ui.js` (queue, task and expected-date dialogs, protocol, activity, segments); commands live in `crm-automation.js` (`PemaCRM`).
rules: "Khách đặt lịch chưa được tính là đã quay lại. Chỉ ghi nhận quay lại khi check-in sau CSKH." (a booking after CSKH is not a returned patient until a check-in).
gotchas: Every CSKH dialog uses `crm-modal` with its own `#crm-error` line; errors of the commands are shown there, not in a toast.

logic: Studio is `clinic.js › studio()/photos()`; resources and services are `operations-ui.js › resources()/services()` with the dialogs `block` and `service`.

Cashier is `operations-ui.js › cashier()`; the quick-order dialog and the order history are `order-ui.js`; the A5 review page is `order-review/index.html` + `order-review.js`; data and rules are `order-data.js`.
rules: "AI chỉ là bản nháp" principle for orders: a draft needs the responsible doctor's approval before it is printed or shown in the patient app ("Đơn nháp cần bác sĩ duyệt trước khi in.").

logic: Finance PB02 is `prototype/finance/finance.js` (`PemaFinance.html()` + `mount(root)`), mounted inside the clinic shell; data comes from the Python API `finance_server.py` on 127.0.0.1:4174 with the headers `X-Pema-Role` and `X-Pema-Doctor`.
rules: Revenue ("Doanh số thực hiện") follows the completion date of the procedure; cash ("Thực thu") follows the receipt date; they are tracked separately.
"Tiền thủ thuật đã duyệt": "Không phải lợi nhuận phòng khám".
gotchas: The tab content refreshes every 10 s (`setInterval`) unless an input has focus or the entry form is open; a pending form is never overwritten (`dirty` flag).
Without the API the page shows "Chưa kết nối dữ liệu tài chính: <error>. Chạy python prototype/finance_server.py rồi thử lại." in `#error` (see WG9).

logic: "Ask Pema" is `clinic.js › ask()` (a scripted query over the demo state, no model); the guide is `guide.js` (`PemaGuide.render()` and its navigation).

The whole phone web is one script, `shared/patient.js` (an IIFE; page `patient-mobile/index.html` only holds `<div id="app">` and the script tags). Module state: `screen`, `identity`, `group`, `historyLimit` and the send-update drafts. `render()` picks one of `home`, `appointments`, `journey`, `progress`, `care`, `send`, `messages`, `docs`, `profile`; `app(content)` wraps it with the top bar (logo, avatar button "ML" that opens Hồ sơ), `<main class="mobile-content">` and the bottom `<nav class="mobile-nav">`.

Navigation is data-driven: every `data-screen` button switches screen (and resets the history limit to 3), every `data-action` button calls `action()`. The bottom navigation has five items, "Trang chủ", "Lịch hẹn", "Hành trình", "Tin nhắn", "Hồ sơ". Sub-screens keep a parent item lit: `progress`, `care` and `send` light "Hành trình"; `docs` lights "Hồ sơ" (so WI6, WI7, WI8 and WI9 show a different active item than their back button suggests). Back buttons: "← Trang chủ", "← Hành trình", "← Hồ sơ", "← Chăm sóc tại nhà".

`shared/care-finance.js › injectMobile` appends the card "Đơn & phiếu đã duyệt" (class `mobile-linked-prescriptions`) under the Trang chủ, Hồ sơ and Tài liệu & hóa đơn screens. It lists only what a doctor approved (prescription, and approved cashier orders with "Đơn thuốc" and "Phiếu tư vấn"); otherwise it shows the chip "Chưa có" and "Đơn và phiếu sẽ xuất hiện sau khi bác sĩ duyệt."

Data is the demo store `Pema.state` (localStorage, shared with the clinic web of the same origin) and `pema-patient-identity` (the chosen synthetic patient, default P001). A change made in the clinic web shows here on the next render (`pema-external` and `pema-change` events), except while the send or progress screen is open so a draft is never wiped.

Feedback is a toast only: `showToast(msg)` re-renders with `<div class="mobile-toast" role="status" aria-live="polite">` and clears it after 2.8 s (the whole screen is rendered again both times). A failed save (`saveOrRollback`) restores the state and toasts "Không lưu được thay đổi. Dữ liệu và bản nháp vẫn được giữ lại."
rules: There is no native browser dialog (`confirm`, `prompt`, `alert`) in the phone web (checked in `patient.js` and `index.html`): every message is a toast or an inline line, so no id of this group needs a captured native text.
gotchas: Primary frame is 390×844. From 701px up, `.mobile-app` is a 460px column (max-width) of 100dvh with a scrolling `.mobile-content` and the bottom navigation inside the column, so the 1440×900 snapshot shows the column at x 490 and the probes at 1920, 1280, 1024 and 390 report "no layout change". What the probes cannot see changes at ≤700px (design.css): content padding 20px, top bar padding 22px 20px, `.mobile-heading` 28px, `.mobile-card` padding 18px, logo 112px; at max-height 740px the home cards compact (heading 22-23px, quick-action captions hidden); at ≤370px the nav font is 10px.
Every screen has the same frame (top bar, content, bottom navigation, and the toast when one is up), so the ids differ only in the content. The snapshot scope is `body`.

Icon glyphs typed as characters in the code (✓ ✦ ⚙ ▤ ▧ ＋ › ▢) are swapped for lucide icons at render (`PemaUI.enhance`) and are not part of the labels in the snapshot (the label of "＋ Gửi tin nhắn" is "Gửi tin nhắn"); the web canvas draws icons from the kit.

Accessible names that are not visible text: the avatar button "Mở hồ sơ demo của <tên>", the session rail "<n> trên <total> buổi hoàn tất", the progress bar "Số buổi điều trị đã hoàn tất", the quick action "Xem hướng dẫn", the faces "Trước — minh họa tổng hợp, không phải ảnh bệnh nhân" and "Gần nhất — …", the file input "Ảnh cập nhật cho Pema", the consent box "Đồng ý để Pema xem ảnh cập nhật" and the preview "Xem trước ảnh cập nhật" (alt "Ảnh cập nhật đã chọn — bản demo").

Patient data is the synthetic store (46 patients; the default profile is P001, phone masked as "09•• ••• 100"). Screens of a toast (WI23, WI28, WI29, WI31, WI33, WI34, WI38-WI40) are captured while the toast is up (2.8 s) and list it as a `notice` with role "status".

logic: `clinic.js › shell()` draws sidebar and topbar; `staff-context.js › picker()` draws the demo account select; `finance-bridge.js` adds the finance sync link in the topbar.
rules: The sidebar shows only the pages of the role (`pages` in `staff-context.js`); a section title with no visible item is removed.
differences: The old web shell is a left sidebar of 13 items in 3 sections; the app (A5, A6) uses a bottom navigation per role plus "Đổi không gian làm việc".
gotchas: "Đặt lại dữ liệu demo" (`#reset-demo`) asks a native `confirm('Đặt lại dữ liệu demo?')`, then toasts "Đã khôi phục dữ liệu demo".
The global search answers Enter only: it sets the patient search and opens "Tìm bệnh nhân".
The bell button is a link to "Theo dõi" (`data-nav=followups`).
The finance link in the top bar has three states from `finance-bridge.js`: "Tài chính đã đồng bộ", "Đang đồng bộ tài chính…", "Tài chính chờ kết nối · thử lại"; the canvas draws the first one.
The canvas draws the content area as a placeholder: each page is drawn by its own group (WB-WH).

logic: `staff-context.js › home()`: care lands on `crm`, accountant on `cashier`, everyone else on `dashboard`.
gotchas: Care sees 4 menu items only (Điều phối lịch, Tìm bệnh nhân, CSKH hôm nay, Hướng dẫn).
The care shell keeps the finance link "Tài chính đã đồng bộ" (old shot) although care has no finance page.
The landing page "CSKH hôm nay" is drawn in full by group WD (WD1); WA2 draws only its heading and the four KPI tiles for context, with demo numbers from the canvas.
differences: The canvas top bar always draws the bell; the old web shows it for owner and doctor only (care sees the finance link but no bell). Template change needed, see the W3b-WA report.

logic: Accountant menu: Tài chính, Thu ngân, Tìm bệnh nhân, Hướng dẫn; capabilities `billing` and `readFinance`.
differences: The canvas top bar always draws the bell; the old web shows it for owner and doctor only (accountant has the finance link but no bell). Template change needed, see the W3b-WA report.
gotchas: The landing page "Thu ngân" is drawn in full by group WF; WA3 draws only its heading and the four KPI tiles for context.

logic: `clinic.js › toast(msg)` removes any existing `.toast`, appends a `div.toast` to `body` and removes it after 2800 ms.
gotchas: The toast is outside `#app`; the snapshot adds any visible `.toast` to the tree of every screen.
The toast is a fixed pill at the bottom right of the viewport, above the page content; the page behind it ("Hôm nay", drawn in full at WB3) is only context.
Check-in and Vắng act at once: the row's status badge changes and the buttons become "Bắt đầu" (Đã đến) or "Mời vào phòng" (Đang chờ); no dialog opens.

logic: `crm-ui.js › dashboard()` (owner and care-less roles); the doctor sees `doctorHome()` instead (WB2). KPI numbers come from `PemaCRM.metrics()` and the appointments of `DAY`.
Every KPI button is a `data-crm="queue"` entry that opens "CSKH hôm nay" with a filter (`all`, `no_show`, `overdue`, `at_risk`, `abandoned`).
rules: "Hóa đơn, không phải thực thu": "Phát sinh hôm nay" counts invoices dated today, not money received.
Lifecycle groups ("Khách mới", "Khách quay lại", "Đang điều trị", "Lâu chưa quay lại", "Đã quay lại sau CSKH") open the segment dialog WD5.
differences: App I1 shows 3 CSKH metrics ("Cần CSKH", "Quá hạn", "Nguy cơ mất"); the web has 4 KPI buttons ("Khách cần CSKH", "Quá ngày dự kiến", "Nguy cơ mất khách", "Liệu trình bỏ dở") plus the panels "Hiệu quả CSKH" and "Vòng đời khách hàng" that the app does not show.
The web page eyebrow is "Pema · chăm sóc xuyên suốt" and the subtitle ends with "mốc demo 20/09/2026"; the app shows 22/09/2026.
App I1 puts "Phát sinh hôm nay" in one tile with the sentence; the web uses a metric card with the quiet button "Hóa đơn, không phải thực thu →".

logic: `crm-ui.js › doctorHome()`: title "Không gian bác sĩ · <name>", three KPI buttons (`doctor-today`, `doctor-patients`, `doctor-followups`), table "Lịch khám của tôi". Own visits only (`PemaStaff.owns`).
rules: "Không bao gồm dashboard CSKH hoặc tài chính toàn phòng khám" (subtitle of "Lịch khám của tôi").
differences: App B1/B2 are the doctor workspace in mobile shape; the web adds the link "Doanh số của tôi →" to finance.

logic: `crm-ui.js › today()`: reception list of the appointments of `DAY`, 25 per page, filters `todayStatus`, `todayDoctor`, `todayQuery`; the status tiles are `data-crm="today-status"` buttons.
Row buttons run `PemaCRM.reception(id, status)` (check-in `arrive`, `start`, `missed`) and toast "Đã cập nhật hàng đợi".
rules: Status words: booked "Chưa đến" (also counts confirmed), arrived "Đang chờ", in_progress "Đang khám/điều trị", completed "Hoàn tất", cancelled "Đã hủy", missed "Vắng hẹn".
Doctors see only their own visits and no invoice total ("Phát sinh hóa đơn hôm nay" is hidden for role doctor).
differences: App I2 lists "Tổng lịch", "Đang chờ", "Hoàn tất" and a status chip row; the web has 8 reception tiles that act as filters, a doctor select, a search field and paging ("← Trước", "Sau →").

Canvas WB3: the six status tiles are drawn as buttons "31 Chưa đến" … "0 Vắng hẹn" in a 4-column grid beside "Tổng lịch" and "Đã đến"; the old web shows all 8 in one row. Sample rows show every status with its action: Check-in + Vắng (Chưa đến, Đã xác nhận), "Mời vào phòng" (Đang chờ), "Mở 360" (all others), as in crm-ui.js.
gotchas: The money tile "Phát sinh hóa đơn hôm nay" is missing for the doctor role (WB4 and WB2 use other roles).

logic: Same `today()` with a search that matches nothing; the table body becomes one empty row.
differences: Canvas WB4: the table header is followed by the line "Không có lịch phù hợp." instead of a full-width empty row.

logic: `operations-ui.js › schedule()`: day board by room (half-hour `drop-slot` buttons, 60 px per half hour, `positioned-booking` cards) or 7-day list; filters `ops-date`, `ops-doctor`, `ops-room`; view toggle `data-ops="view"` (`day`, `week`).
Dragging a `.booking` onto a `.drop-slot` opens the booking dialog with the new date, time and room (`ondrop` → `edit({...a, date, time, room})`); opening a card opens the details dialog.
rules: A doctor account has the doctor filter locked to its own doctor (`PemaStaff.apply()` disables `#ops-doctor`).
Doctor shifts 08:00–18:00 with a break 12:00–13:00; "Ngoài ca bác sĩ hoặc trùng giờ nghỉ 12:00–13:00."
differences: App I3/A2 show a week strip and a day list; the web board is a room-by-time grid with drag and drop, the legend of the four service colours and the side panel "Chờ xếp lịch".

Canvas WB5: booking cards show time, patient and "BS. · Đặt hẹn" (the service is the card colour, named in the legend); the old card also repeats the service name and "· +15′ đệm" in the time line. The hatched "15′ chuẩn bị phòng" blocks are drawn as small cards of the board block, which has no hatched buffer kind (open item). The 60 empty half-hour slots (buttons "Đặt lịch <phòng> <giờ>", ops=new) are not drawn: the board block has no empty-slot buttons (open item). The canvas shows 08:00–12:00 with one booking per hour per room; the old grid scrolls 08:00–18:00.
gotchas: The 4 service colours are the classes `service-S0..S3` (calendar legend and booking cards).
Drag and drop is mouse only (`draggable=true`); keyboard users open the card and use the dialog.

logic: Same `schedule()` with `view = 'week'`: seven `week-day` columns starting at the chosen date, each with a title "CN, 20/09" and the day's bookings.
differences: Canvas WB6: 7 columns at 1440 truncate long names; the old web keeps 178 px columns and scrolls horizontally. Each day shows 3 sample cards, the count in the day header is the old one.

logic: `operations-ui.js › edit()` with no id: title "Đặt lịch hẹn", form `#booking-form`, live preview line `#booking-preview` ("<n> phút điều trị + <m> phút chuẩn bị · <price>"), error line `#ops-error`.
Submit calls `PemaOps.saveAppointment` and toasts "Đã lưu lịch và cập nhật Patient 360"; the button "Tìm giờ trống" runs `suggest` (tries 15-minute steps from 08:00 to 17:45).
rules: "Hãy chọn bệnh nhân, dịch vụ, bác sĩ và phòng."
"Phòng không phù hợp với dịch vụ đã chọn."
"Dịch vụ hoặc phòng đang tạm ngưng."
"Ngoài ca bác sĩ hoặc trùng giờ nghỉ 12:00–13:00."
"Trùng thời gian khóa: <lý do>" when a room or doctor block overlaps.
"Trùng bệnh nhân|bác sĩ với lịch <giờ> của <tên>." and "Phòng đang bận hoặc đang chuẩn bị sau lịch <giờ>."
"Chỉ xếp lịch cho bác sĩ đang đăng nhập demo." (doctor role).
"Không có giờ trống cho lựa chọn này. Hãy đổi ngày, bác sĩ hoặc phòng."
differences: App I4/F8 book with a bottom sheet and a week strip; the web is one dialog with 8 fields, the preview and "Tìm giờ trống".
The close button "Đóng hộp thoại" (the X) is drawn by the dialog block without its accessible label.
gotchas:
Every ops dialog ends with an empty `

`; it has no text until a rule error is thrown, so it is not drawn in the layout.

logic: `operations-ui.js › edit(a)` with an id: title "Chi tiết lịch hẹn", a status chip, the buttons "Xác nhận lịch" (`ops=confirm`), "Check-in" (`ops=arrive`), "Patient 360 →" (`ops=profile`), the same booking form ("Lưu thay đổi", "Tìm giờ trống") and below it "Lý do hủy" with "Hủy lịch hẹn" (`ops=cancel`).
rules: "Cần lý do hủy cho lịch đang hoạt động."
"Không thể chuyển trạng thái lịch này." (only confirmed and arrived are allowed targets).
differences: The close button "Đóng hộp thoại" (the X) is drawn by the dialog block without its accessible label.

logic: `data-ops="wait"` on a waiting-list card opens the booking dialog with the waiting patient, service and note; the form carries `data-wait=<waitlist id>` so the entry leaves the list when saved.
differences: The close button "Đóng hộp thoại" (the X) is drawn by the dialog block without its accessible label.

logic: `clinic.js › patients()`: search `#patient-search` (name, code, concern, phone), filter chips `data-patient-filter` (`all`, `active`, `next`, `alerts`), table 46 rows, "＋ Hồ sơ mới" opens the create dialog WC3. Only patients the account owns are listed (`Staff.owns`).
rules: "Tái khám tuần này" = next visit between 2026-09-20 and 2026-09-27; "Đang điều trị" = completed < total; "Có cảnh báo" = alerts not empty.
differences: App A3 is titled "Hồ sơ người bệnh" with 12 sample rows; the web title is "Tìm bệnh nhân", the count chip "46 hồ sơ" and 4 filter chips.
gotchas: Phone numbers are masked in the demo ("09•• ••• 100").

Canvas: rows 2-7 of the sample table carry the other six concern chips ("Mụn viêm" ... "Theo dõi da sau điều trị"); the generated Layout lists only the first table row, so they are exempted through demo_data. The avatar, name link and "P001 · 28 tuổi · phone" line share one cell.

logic: Empty state of `patients()`: "Không tìm thấy hồ sơ", "Thử tên, mã hồ sơ hoặc mối quan tâm khác." and a clear-search button.
gotchas: Canvas: the empty state is one EmptyState block (icon "search" replaces the old "⌕" glyph, title, hint, "Xóa tìm kiếm"); the snapshot reads it as one concatenated string, so it is exempted through demo_data.

logic: `data-modal="patient"` → `modalHtml('patient')`; `action('create-patient')` saves a synthetic profile and toasts "Đã tạo hồ sơ demo"; an empty name toasts "Nhập tên người bệnh".
gotchas: Canvas: the dialog close button (old aria-label "Đóng hộp thoại") is drawn by the dlg helper as an icon; the generated Layout does not name it, so the label is exempted through demo_data.

logic: `clinic.js › overview(p)` after `PemaCRMUI.summary(p)`; below it `care-finance.js` adds "Dịch vụ & liệu trình", "Đơn thuốc" and "Đơn thuốc & phiếu tư vấn".
Hero buttons: "AI brief" (`data-modal=note`), "Nhắn tin" (`data-modal=message`), "Ghi buổi điều trị" (`data-tab=session`).
rules: "Chỉ đơn đã duyệt mới xuất hiện trên Patient Mobile" (subtitle of "Đơn thuốc").
"Ảnh minh họa tổng hợp cho prototype. Ảnh lâm sàng thật cần gắn vùng chụp, tư thế, thời điểm và đồng ý sử dụng."
differences: App F1 is a vertical list of cards (care, session, next visit, tiền thủ thuật, links to tabs); the web hero, tab bar, three summary figures, journey timeline, milestone photos, AI brief, facts and linked panels are all on one wide page.
gotchas: The brief on this tab is the text of the AI brief dialog (WC13); "AI chỉ là bản nháp": the doctor must edit and approve it.

logic: `PemaCRMUI.clinical(p)` (history and diagnosis form `#crm-clinical-form`) then `clinic.js › consult(p)` (note area + AI draft).
rules: "AI chỉ tạo bản nháp. Bác sĩ cần xem, sửa và xác nhận trước khi lưu vào hồ sơ."
"Bác sĩ ghi nhận, không dùng AI tự chẩn đoán" (subtitle of "Tiền sử & chẩn đoán").
"Nhập tiền sử và nhận định/chẩn đoán do bác sĩ xác nhận." when saving empty.
Draft flow: "Tạo bản nháp ghi chú" (toast "Đã tạo bản nháp — hãy kiểm tra trước khi duyệt") then "Duyệt & lưu vào Patient 360" (toast "Đã duyệt và nối vào Patient 360").
differences: App J1/F2 shows the same flow in one column; the web has two columns "Tư vấn lâm sàng" and "Bản nháp của Pema AI".

logic: Same tab after "Tạo bản nháp ghi chú": the callout title becomes "Bản nháp đã tạo · chờ duyệt" and the textarea `#editable-draft` and the approve button appear.
gotchas: An empty draft toasts "Bản nháp không được để trống"; an empty input toasts "Hãy nhập vài ý chính trước".

logic: `clinic.js › plan(p)`: plan name, goal text, one list item per planned session (`Buổi n · Đã hoàn tất | Tiếp theo | Dự kiến`), side panel "Bộ tiêu chí theo dõi" and the question callout. "Chỉnh sửa" opens WC17.
differences: App J3 lists sessions only; the web adds the tracking criteria facts ("Ảnh mốc", "Patient reported outcome", "Người duyệt", "Nhắc hẹn").
